# Freelancer

> > Freelancer is a global marketplace connecting 50+ million freelancers with clients across 1800+ job categories, enabling skill-based hiring and project outsourcing.

Freelancer operates as a comprehensive freelance marketplace platform featuring specialized directories across creative, technical, business, and administrative services. The platform emphasizes location-based and skill-based search capabilities to match clients with qualified professionals across diverse industries.

## Key Topics

- Freelance marketplace
- Skill-based hiring
- Freelancer directory
- Project categories
- Location-based search
- Creative professionals
- Software development
- Web development
- Graphic design
- Digital marketing
- Virtual assistants
- Designer directory
- Mobile app development
- WordPress
- React.js

## Core Marketplace

- [Freelancer Marketplace Homepage](https://www.freelancer.com): Main landing page connecting 50m+ freelancers with job seekers globally
- [Browse All Job Categories](https://www.freelancer.com/hire): Primary hiring hub with access to 1800+ job categories across all specializations

## Technology & Development Services

- [Hire Software Developers](https://www.freelancer.com/hire/software-development): Software developers marketplace for full-stack, backend, frontend, and specialized development roles
- [Hire Web Developers](https://www.freelancer.com/hire/web-development): Web developers marketplace with expertise in WordPress, Shopify, and modern frameworks
- [Hire Mobile Developers](https://www.freelancer.com/hire/mobile-development): Mobile app developers directory specializing in iOS, Android, and cross-platform development

## Design & Creative Services

- [Hire Graphic Designers](https://www.freelancer.com/hire/graphic-design): Graphic design specialists directory for visual branding and creative design projects
- [Hire Web Designers](https://www.freelancer.com/hire/website-design): Website design professionals marketplace for UI/UX and responsive web design
- [Hire Logo Designers](https://www.freelancer.com/hire/logo-design): Logo design specialists and graphic design professionals for brand identity
- [Hire 3D Designers](https://www.freelancer.com/hire/3d-design): 3D design specialists with modeling, rendering, and visualization expertise
- [Hire Illustrators](https://www.freelancer.com/hire/illustration): Illustrators directory for creative professional artwork and visual content
- [Hire Fashion Designers](https://www.freelancer.com/hire/fashion-design): Fashion designers and design services for apparel and accessory projects

## Marketing & Business Services

- [Hire Digital Marketing Specialists](https://www.freelancer.com/hire/internet-marketing): Digital marketing and internet marketing specialists for online campaigns and growth
- [Hire SEO Experts](https://www.freelancer.com/hire/seo): SEO experts and specialists marketplace for search engine optimization projects
- [Hire Writers](https://www.freelancer.com/hire/writing): Writers and content creators marketplace for copywriting, blogging, and content services

## Administrative & Support Services

- [Hire Virtual Assistants](https://www.freelancer.com/hire/virtual-assistant): Virtual assistants marketplace for administrative, clerical, and support services
- [Hire Data Entry Professionals](https://www.freelancer.com/hire/data-entry): Data entry clerks and administrative professionals for data management projects
- [Hire Translators](https://www.freelancer.com/hire/translation): Translators directory for multilingual professional services and localization

## Specialized Professional Services

- [Hire Financial Experts](https://www.freelancer.com/hire/finance): Financial experts and professional services marketplace for accounting and finance
- [Hire Manufacturing Experts](https://www.freelancer.com/hire/manufacturing): Manufacturing experts and technical professionals directory for industrial projects
- [Hire Logistics Professionals](https://www.freelancer.com/hire/logistics-shipping): Logistics and shipping professionals marketplace for supply chain and operations
